title: Credit Builder Accounts Returned-Payment Fee Relief at Early Closure
content:
## The relief

An early-closure returned-fee relief is granted without a request when a borrower with a pending early-closure request still owes the returned-payment fee of the account's most recent returned payment, and is booked as a courtesy waiver that counts toward the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months but is granted however many have already been granted on the account; a goodwill credit on a late fee, a returned-payment fee relief once its payment has been made good and an early-closure late-fee relief each follow their own rule, and any other courtesy waiver is still granted on request when fewer than the plan's courtesy waivers per 12 months have been granted on the account.

Being granted without a request, the early-closure returned-fee relief is not held to the fee waiver request window, whatever the fee's age, and the early-closure late-fee relief and the made-good relief are likewise governed by their own rules; every other courtesy waiver must still be requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date.

While the account has a pending early-closure request, this relief takes priority over the made-good relief on the same returned-payment fee, and no made-good relief is granted on that fee.

| Credit Builder account facts | Early-closure returned-fee relief |
|---|---|
| an early-closure request pending confirmation, and the borrower still owes the returned-payment fee of the most recent returned payment | granted, with no request and whatever the fee's age |
| the plan's courtesy waivers already granted on the account | still granted; it counts toward that number |
| no pending early-closure request | this relief does not arise |

## Booking the relief: `relieve_returned_fee_at_closing_90cd40e1`

**What it does.** The tool grants the early-closure relief on one returned-payment fee of a Credit Builder account. It books a fee waiver entry with the courtesy basis, dated today and linked to the returned-payment fee it relieves, and lowers the account's unpaid fees by the relief. The borrower sees the relief and the lower unpaid-fee balance on the account.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `relieve_returned_fee_at_closing_90cd40e1` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `builder_account_id` | reference number of the Credit Builder account, as returned by the Credit Builder account lookup |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the returned-payment fee entry being relieved, as listed among the account's entries by the Credit Builder entry lookup |
| `relief_amount` | the relief in USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Early-closure relief <entry reference> of <amount> USD booked on <account reference> against fee <entry reference>; unpaid fees now <amount> USD.", where amounts are in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving this text means the relief is on the account.
